1. (Judgment 1) Tonight reads as a rerun of 2026-10-13, "an orbit chart, the finish at dead center." It repeats the radial, centre-zone orbit silhouette with day-fact satellites, footer-only and hero-only. It also repeats the gold-family drench (34° against 48°) and the caps, roman, centred fatface register. Change at least two of these so a returning visitor cannot mistake the night: the orbit silhouette, the hue family, or the type register.

2. (Judgment 4) At 360, fold 1 holds the "FINAL · SATURDAY · DETROIT PISTONS" kicker and the deck paragraph ("Seventeen points of daylight…"). The Mobile Declaration's `first_fold` asks for the mark, the stacked 128/111 and its caption "and nothing else." Move the kicker and deck below the fold, or drop them at 360.

3. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman entry reads "The studio I founded to take products end to end — from the first idea through the thing that ships. Everything after it is a variation on that habit." The records describe Spaceman as the LLC he has operated under for independent design and engineering work, partnering with companies and studios. Replace this with copy drawn from the record's problem, approach and outcome.

4. (Judgment 2) The oxblood +17 chip sits over the top of the "8" in 128. At 360 it covers most of the bowl, so the winning number reads as "12_". Pull the chip clear of the glyph so it tags the 128 without hiding it.

5. (Judgment 6) At 360 the numbered nav runs as a wrapping row: "01 WORK 02 ABOUT" on one line and "03 CONTACT" on the next. `nav_360` declares a stacked 01/02/03 list in the knockout band. Set it as a stacked list.

1. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman entry reads "partnering with companies and studios to take products from first idea to the thing that ships. It's the umbrella every project since runs under." The record says "the LLC I've operated under for the past decade, partnering with companies and studios across industries," with work spanning product design, frontend engineering, design systems and brand. Nothing in the records says every project runs under Spaceman, and FishSticks and 15th Club are listed as separate founder projects. Replace the line with wording drawn from the record's approach and outcome.

2. (Judgment 4) At 360 a "Scoring by Quarter" bar chart sits between the figure and golf. The Mobile Declaration's `order` runs mark, figure + caption, golf, moon, market, weather, home callout, footer. Either drop the chart or move it out of the declared satellite sequence.

3. (Judgment 3) At 1440 the composition is declared `radial`, with satellites orbiting the score and the moon disc pulled off-axis. The page instead shows the score above a two-column ruled table (the quarter chart and "The Rest of Saturday"), with no orbit and no moon disc. Place golf, moon, market and weather as satellites around the centred score in columns 1 and 3, so the eye moves outward from the figure as the brief intends.

1. (Judgment 1) This reruns 2026-10-13's "orbit chart, the finish at dead center and the day's figures" around it. It repeats that night's radial silhouette with satellites circling a centred hero, its warm-gold drench (34° here against 48° then), its caps/centred type and its footer-only/hero-only shell. The hero line also reuses the "Red Wings edge it, 4–3" / "take it, 5–3" formula from 10-18 and 10-07. Break at least the silhouette: drop the circular satellite discs ringing the centre, and set the day's figures some other way, for example as a box-score rail or a stepped flip-board.

2. (Judgment 4) At 360, fold 1 shows the deck paragraph and the top of the golf satellite under the caption. The Mobile Declaration's `first_fold` names the mark, the stacked 128/111 and its caption, "and nothing else." Push the deck and the golf disc below the fold.

3. (Judgment 4) The filmstrip adds a zone the declared `order` does not name: the "Analysis · Scoring by quarter" bar chart in fold 3. Its quarter splits (32–28, 34–26, 30–29, 32–28) are invented, not in the signal. Remove it, or have the brief declare it and source the data.

4. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman copy in fold 4 says "taking each engagement from first idea to the thing that ships." The record says only that the work spans product design, frontend engineering, design systems and brand, "sometimes as a solo contributor, sometimes embedded in a larger team." Replace the invented clause with the record's wording.

5. (Judgment 2) On the phone, the ghost "DETROIT" texture runs straight behind the golf satellite at the foot of fold 1 and the top of fold 2. The tiny "Butterfield Bermuda · Hirata / Blanchet, tied" label is set over the letterforms there. Keep the readable satellite copy clear of the texture, or end the texture above it.
